input: Right, so I've been thinking about the memory folder, and, you know, the way we write the day pages is kind of wasteful, because every new dictation rebuilds the whole month, like, even when only one entry changed. So basically what I want is, like, an incremental writer that only touches the day page and the index, and keeps the topic pages as they are unless the entry is filed under a topic. Make sure the writes stay atomic and owner-only, and, you know, don't break the agent skill, because Claude Code and omp both read those pages. Also, the session pages, I think they should only be rebuilt when the session title changes, not on every dictation.
